caption: Kar. 86. Altar
notes: Line 1: the s of wos is drawn with a long hook to the left, and Griffith's '2 sic' stands over the hook; the hook could be a separate sign. No line number 3 is printed anywhere in the copy; line 3 must begin inside the hatched gap or the copy omits it. The hatched gap after soreyi is about 3 signs wide, with stray strokes at its left end. 'tllosewi': the two l are the small hooked l form; '3/' read as o + s. Line 4 'tq?ye': '/3' could also be s + o. Line 5 'tedḫel?o': the l is hatched. 'atẖ?yli': the sign after t is a 3 with an inner loop (ẖ or w). Line 7 'te te' at the end: both are a slash and a barred hook, te or o + l; Griffith marks 'end' to its left.

caption: Kar. 87. Stela-altar
reading: wosi : soreyi : ḫs?loy?kqo : (2)wi : ant : mniḫwi : atepld?w?q(3)leḫ : wilowi : sente?leḫ : wilo(4)wi : m?lo : m?rse : ak?edtelowi : a?(5)to? : mẖe : psoẖekete : at mẖe : psḫ(6)r?ke?te : ḫẖlol : q?ekete :
notes: Line number 2 is printed '2?'. Line 1 name: the sign after o is hatched with '?' over it (y?); the long-tailed sign is k (could be p). 'ant :' the t's dot and the divider share two dots. Line 2-3 'atepld...': p is the xi-form with long tail; d is a rising stroke with hook; the small looped sign after d is unclear (w?); '/3' read q (could be s + o). 'wilowi' twice: the copy shows δ4 /ϛ δ4 between dividers. 'sente?leḫ': te could be l + o. Line 4 'm?lo', 'm?rse': the first sign is a flat-topped 3 (m, ẖ or s). 'ak?ed': the long-tailed 2 could be the tail of a second a. Line 5 'a?': the S of a is hatched; 'to?' is an angle with a long base. 'psoẖekete' and 'psḫr?ke?te': the 3-shaped signs set by the formula; r and e are hatched. Line 6 'q?ekete': '/3' could be s + o. Signs 3-shaped throughout (m, ẖ, s) are uncertain.

caption: Kar. 88. Altar (Kar. Cem., Pl. 17, No. 7096)
reading: wosi : (2)asore(3)yi : s?bly?eqowi : stki(4)ñye : tedḫl?owi : biike(5)mome : terik?elowi : n?(6)[.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.]d? : yetm(7)dolo(8)wi : mdek? : (9)s?ittowi : stm?detowi : (10)ato mẖe : psoẖete : (11)at : mẖe : psḫrk (12)te : ḫẖy(13)l : (14)psqekete : wosi (15)asoreyi : slolo(16)wi :
notes: Line 6: Griffith notes '7 or 8 signs lost'; written as 7 lost plus one broken stroke before d? = 8 [.]. The first sign of that row is a hatched ʌ with long tail (n?). Line 7 'yetm(7)dolo': Griffith's 'sic' stands over the o (expected e) and d. 'stki(4)ñye': ñ is a ʌ with a hook (could be n). 'tedḫl?owi': the sign between ḫ and o is S-shaped (e or l). 'biike(5)mome': '7/7' could hold q. Line 9 group 's?ittowi': to is the cup with dot below. 'at : mẖe' in line 11: two dots before the t hook (t's dot + divider?). 'ḫẖy(13)l': the /// carries 'sic'. Line 14 'psqekete': '/3' read q. 'psoẖete' line 10: '3/3' read o between two 3-shapes.

caption: Kar. 89. Stela (Kar. Cem., Pl. 18, No. 7099)
reading: wosi : soreyi : wi(2)ritelitoqowi : (3)kleqdye : tedḫe(4)lowi : sqr : m?npse t(5)rosetme : terikelowi : (6)ant mnpse : mnote?e : yet(7)mdelowi : ant : mnpse br(8)tre : s?telowi : ant : t?ni : s?(9)telowi : sed?te? m?n?pset? s?s?ke(10)l : mn?i?ḫwi : qki : mnp?se mere(11)mteboliñ?e : a?tos : belimet(12)ye : s?k?ni : mni(13)sebeliliñ?t : s?telowi : kiisebetowi : sleqed : (14)mnpse : yiremln? : semlowi : ato mẖe : p(15)soẖekete : (16)a?t mẖe : psi(17)ḫrkete : (18)ḫẖlol : ps(19)l?k?ete : ḫl?ẖl? : (20)psitḫ?kete : w[.]si soreyi
notes: Line 13 is copied in two pieces: the right piece at the level of the '13', the left piece (from 'kiisebetowi') lower, at the left margin; read right piece then left piece. Line 19 is printed '19?' with 'sic' over the long-tailed sign after it (k?). The last row (w[.]si soreyi) has no line number. 'ant : t?ni :?' line 6: the divider after t?ni carries '?'; the first sign has a dot (t) though the parallel in Kar. 87 is mni. The 'mnpse' groups: first sign is a 2/7 shape (m), third a Σ-topped long-tailed sign read p by the word. '/3' read q (kleqdye, sqr, qki); each could be s + o. 'ḫẖlol' and 'ḫl?ẖl?': the l are S-shaped (e or l). 'psi(17)ḫrkete' and '(20)psitḫ?kete': the cup without dot after t read ḫ (could be to). 'yiremln?': first sign is crossed strokes (y?). 'a?t mẖe' line 16: the a is hatched. 'mere(11)mteboliñ?e', 'belimet(12)ye', 'sebeliliñ?t': ν read b; 4ϛ pairs read l + i.

caption: Kar. 90. Altar (Kar. Cem., Pl. 15, No. 7090)
reading: [.][.]si : (2)soreyi : (3)aq?skseqowi : ble(4)kewiteke : tedḫlowi : (5)qelos?r?[.][.]terikelo(6)wi : pese(7)tol : (8)yetmde(9)lowi : atep?ede(10)q? : semlowi : a(11)to : mẖe : psiẖ?te : at : (12)mẖe : psi(13)ḫrkte
notes: Line 1: the start (wo?) is hatched, about 2 signs. The '2' stands over the divider before soreyi; the '5' over the divider at the end of the second row. Line 3 'aq?': the slash of q is crossed through (damaged). Line 5: after qelo a hatched 3 and hatched ω (s? r?), a dot, then about 2 signs' width of hatching before terikelowi; any divider there is lost. Line 8 'pese(7)tol': p read by the title pesto; the sign is Σ-topped (could be k). Line 10 'atep?ede(10)q?': '/3' could be s + o. 'at : (12)mẖe': three dots before the t hook (t's dot + divider).
